Use [] when neither rule matches. Ignore path_addition, permission_grant, replacement, context_link, and the primary target itself unless one of the two explicit dependency rules includes it.

primary_target.description: Permission-record identifier at target_id of the applicable permission_grant relation; it is not an arbitrary operational object.

actor_or_role.description: Source identifier of the applicable current permission_grant relation.

decision.description: Return allow when a current permission_grant connects actor_or_role to primary_target and both endpoints are active and not invalidated; otherwise return deny only when the carried state explicitly represents the corresponding denied or revoked authorization.

For dependency or dependency_addition, include target_id when source_id is a primary target. For action_precondition_establishment, include source_id when target_id is a primary target. Use [] when neither rule matches. Ignore path_addition, permission_grant, replacement, context_link, and the primary target itself unless one of the two explicit dependency rules includes it.
